Friends is a theme that was introduced in early 2012, although some sets were available in late 2011. It replaced Belville as the "girl" theme. The theme is more story-based than most, and follows the activities of five…

page.overview:
What is Friends?

Friends is a licensed theme based on the 1994 television show. It was introduced in 2019 under the Ideas line and then in 2021 under Icons.
